description: Commit 1d77c05 pads Linear heads to a multiple of 128 while the return_logits path sizes held logits to a multiple of 32, creating a source-level width mismatch for vocabularies divisible by 32 but not 128.
trigger: Use return_logits with a vocabulary whose size is a multiple of 32 but not 128.
expected_behavior: The model head output and held-logits storage use compatible padded widths.
actual_behavior: The head emits the 128-aligned width while generator/job storage remains 32-aligned; SeqTensor.append behavior for this mismatch was not assessed.

introductions.scope: The task diff changes Linear's default output alignment from exact width to 128; the existing held-logits alignment remains 32.

observations.source: Independent Fable mailbox review of head padding and logits consumers.
observations.reach: The sampler masks columns beyond actual_vocab_size when a tokenizer is supplied. The separate return_logits storage path retains 32-based sizing.
observations.limits: SeqTensor.append and runtime return_logits behavior were not traced or executed.

verification.tree_scope: Commit 1d77c05 introduction and task-tree logits consumers.
limits: No generation, sampling or tensor append was executed.
SeqTensor.append behavior for mismatched widths is unassessed.
The record is suspected because runtime effect is not established.

source.artifact: Commit-32 Linear padding and logits-width source scan

impact.rationale: The source widths disagree on a concrete vocabulary class, but the append consumer and runtime effect remain unassessed.

administrative_review_status: Commit-32 reviewer observation recorded as a suspected candidate awaiting independent ledger review.
